name: Winterdream - Professional High Quality DSLR Photography
description: A LoRA trained for professional camera photography with a dreamy, moody aesthetic and beautiful bokeh. Optimized for realistic and high-quality winter imagery, it captures a wide range of subjects including portraits, landscapes, and animals. Perfect for creating atmospheric, cinematic winter scenes with soft, ethereal light, delicate frost, snow-covered landscapes, and elegant details. Works well for close-ups, wide shots, and artistic compositions, maintaining a natural, immersive, and visually stunning appearance. Settings: 8-9 steps, cfg1, Euler sampler, Normal or Simple scheduler, 832x1216, 1024x1536 or 1280x1920 "However, the resolution is up to you; this is just an example of good quality. Landscape format works just as well as portrait format."
